title: Raindrop Ripple Normal Perturbation Shader
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that loads the 'BrainStem.glb' model and applies a custom raindrop ripple normal-perturbation shader to it. The scene simulates raindrops falling onto the model surface, each creating expanding concentric ripple rings that perturb the surface normals in the fragment shader, producing a dynamic wet-surface look.

## Scene Setup
- Use a dark blue-gray background (0x1a1a2e).
- PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 3) looking at origin.
- OrbitControls for camera interaction.
- One DirectionalLight (intensity 1.2, position 3,5,4) and one AmbientLight (intensity 0.3).
- Load 'BrainStem.glb' using GLTFLoader. Center the model at the origin. Scale it so its bounding box longest axis is approximately 2 units.
- The model should play its default animation if one exists (use AnimationMixer).

## Custom Shader Material
- Replace all mesh materials in the loaded model with a single custom ShaderMaterial.
- The vertex shader passes world-space position, UV, and the original normal/tangent to the fragment shader.
- The fragment shader receives a uniform array of up to 20 ripple descriptors. Each ripple has: vec3 center (world-space hit point), float startTime, float active (1.0 or 0.0).
- For each active ripple, compute the distance from the fragment's world position to the ripple center. The ripple ring expands outward at a speed of 0.8 units/second. The ring has a Gaussian profile (width 0.05) and decays exponentially over 3 seconds (lifetime). The ripple perturbs the surface normal in the tangent plane using a sinusoidal displacement proportional to the ring amplitude.
- Lighting: simple Blinn-Phong with the perturbed normal. Base color uniform (default 0.4, 0.45, 0.55). Specular exponent 64. Specular color white.
- A uniform float 'uTime' is updated every frame with elapsed seconds.
- A uniform float 'uRippleIntensity' controls the amplitude of all ripples (default 1.0, range 0.0-2.0).

## Raindrop Spawning
- Every 0.4 seconds, automatically spawn a new ripple at a random point on the model surface. To pick a random surface point, cast a ray from a random direction toward the model center and use the first intersection. If no intersection, skip.
- Maintain a circular buffer of 20 ripple slots. When a ripple's age exceeds 3 seconds, mark it inactive and reuse the slot.
- Pressing 'R' toggles automatic rain on/off (starts ON).
- Clicking on the model (raycasting from mouse) spawns a manual ripple at the intersection point.

## UI / HUD
- A DOM overlay panel (top-left, semi-transparent dark background, white text, id='hud-panel') showing:
  - 'Active Ripples: N' (id='ripple-count') — number of currently active ripples.
  - 'Rain: ON/OFF' (id='rain-status') — current auto-rain state.
  - 'Intensity: X.XX' (id='intensity-display') — current ripple intensity.
  - 'Total Spawned: N' (id='total-spawned') — cumulative ripples spawned since page load.
- A slider input (id='intensity-slider', min=0, max=2, step=0.01, default 1.0) below the HUD that controls uRippleIntensity.
- A button (id='clear-btn', text 'Clear All') that deactivates all ripples immediately.
- A button (id='burst-btn', text 'Burst 10') that spawns 10 ripples simultaneously at random surface points.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
  - modelLoaded: boolean
  - animationPlaying: boolean (true if mixer is playing)
  - ripples: array of objects {active: bool, age: float, centerX/Y/Z: float} for all 20 slots
  - activeRippleCount: number of active ripples
  - totalSpawned: number (cumulative)
  - rainEnabled: boolean
  - rippleIntensity: float (current uRippleIntensity value)
  - elapsedTime: float (uTime value)
  - cameraDistance: float (distance from camera to origin)
  - lastManualRippleTime: float (elapsedTime when last manual click-ripple was spawned, or -1)
  - lastBurstTime: float (elapsedTime when last burst was triggered, or -1)
  - clearedAtTime: float (elapsedTime when last clear was performed, or -1)
  - rippleSpeed: 0.8
  - rippleLifetime: 3.0
  - maxRipples: 20

## Animation Loop
- Use requestAnimationFrame. Update uTime, AnimationMixer, spawn auto-ripples on schedule, update __3D_STATE__ every frame.
physics_constraints: Ripples expand at exactly 0.8 units/second. Ripple lifetime is exactly 3.0 seconds — after which they must be deactivated. The circular buffer holds exactly 20 slots. Ripple intensity must be clamped to [0, 2]. Active ripple count must always equal the number of slots with active===true. totalSpawned must be monotonically non-decreasing.
